intro: Mosshide Fen is a swampy, treacherous tract in the eastern Wetlands overrun by the Mosshide gnoll tribe. Dotted with primitive encampments, it is one of the most perilous regions for travelers venturing off the main trade roads.

p: Sprawling across the murky eastern reaches of the Wetlands, Mosshide Fen serves as the primary domain of the aggressive Mosshide gnolls. The swamp here is dense and tangled, dotted with rough lean-tos and bone-strewn camps. Under the vicious command of pack leaders like Gnawbone, the gnolls fiercely guard their muddy claims, readily ambushing and devouring any travelers, scouts, or prospectors foolish enough to wander into their hunting grounds.
